Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a beverage item sold by Cayo Drinks, including both fruit drinks and cocktails, available for showcase and ordering.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

name.description: The name of the beverage, e.g., 'Tropical Sunset'.

description.description: A short description detailing the beverage's flavor profile or ingredients.

price.description: The current selling price of the beverage in Ghana Cedis.

currency.description: The currency in which the price is denominated (e.g., 'GH₵').

type.description: The category of the beverage, differentiating between fruit drinks and cocktails.

imageUrl.description: URL to a high-resolution image of the beverage.

isAvailable.description: Indicates whether the product is currently available for purchase.

ingredients.description: A list of key ingredients used in the beverage.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents a customer's order placed through the QR code ordering system, enabling tracking of its status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Order entity.

orderDate.description: The date and time when the order was placed.

customerName.description: The name of the customer placing the order.

customerEmail.description: The email address of the customer for order communication.

customerPhoneNumber.description: The phone number of the customer for order communication.

status.description: The current status of the order, used for tracking progress.

totalAmount.description: The total monetary cost of the order.

currency.description: The currency of the total order amount (e.g., 'GH₵').

pickupTime.description: The scheduled time for order pickup, if the order is for pickup.

deliveryAddress.description: The delivery address for the order, if the order is for delivery.

notes.description: Any special instructions or notes provided by the customer for the entire order.

OrderItem.title: OrderItem
OrderItem.description: Represents a specific product included within an Order, detailing its quantity and price at the time of purchase.

id.description: Unique identifier for the OrderItem entity.

orderId.description: Reference to the Order this item belongs to. (Relationship: Order 1:N OrderItem)

productId.description: Reference to the Product being ordered. (Relationship: Product 1:N OrderItem)

quantity.description: The number of units of the product ordered.

unitPrice.description: The price of a single unit of the product at the time the order was placed.

notes.description: Any specific customization requests or notes for this individual item (e.g., 'no ice', 'extra sugar').

EventBooking.title: EventBooking
EventBooking.description: Represents a customer's inquiry or booking request for Cayo Drinks services for various events, allowing tracking of the booking process.

id.description: Unique identifier for the EventBooking entity.

customerName.description: The full name of the customer or organizer submitting the event booking request.

customerEmail.description: The email address of the customer for all event-related communication.

customerPhoneNumber.description: The phone number of the customer for event communication.

eventType.description: The nature of the event being planned (e.g., wedding, party, corporate event).

eventDate.description: The scheduled date of the event.

eventLocation.description: The venue or specific address where the event will take place.

numberOfGuests.description: The estimated number of attendees expected at the event.

budget.description: The estimated budget allocated for Cayo Drinks services for the event, if provided by the customer.

status.description: The current status of the event booking request, indicating its progress (e.g., pending, confirmed).

notes.description: Additional requirements, special requests, or specific details provided by the customer for the event.

submissionDate.description: The date and time when the event booking request was initially submitted.

GalleryImage.title: GalleryImage
GalleryImage.description: Represents an image displayed in the website's photo gallery, showcasing drinks, ingredients, and events.

id.description: Unique identifier for the GalleryImage entity.

imageUrl.description: The URL to the image file, hosted externally or internally.

altText.description: Alternative text for the image, crucial for accessibility and SEO.

category.description: The classification of the image (e.g., drinks, ingredients, customers, preparation, events).

uploadDate.description: The date and time when the image was uploaded to the gallery.

CompanyInfo.title: CompanyInfo
CompanyInfo.description: Stores general information about Cayo Drinks, including contact details and social media links, primarily for the footer and contact page.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CompanyInfo entity (typically a singleton for global settings).

companyName.description: The official name of the company, 'Cayo Drinks'.

address.description: The physical address of the company.

phoneNumber.description: The primary contact phone number for Cayo Drinks.

email.description: The primary contact email address for customer inquiries.

instagramUrl.description: URL to Cayo Drinks' official Instagram profile.

tiktokUrl.description: URL to Cayo Drinks' official TikTok profile.

brandMessage.description: A short, impactful brand message or slogan displayed in the footer.

definition.description: Collection for all beverage products offered by Cayo Drinks. Publicly readable for menu display. Admin-only for creation, updates, and deletion.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the customer who placed the order.

params.name: orderId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific order.

definition.description: Subcollection containing individual items within a specific order. Each OrderItem document MUST include an 'ownerId' field matching '{userId}' from the parent path, inherited from the Order, for authorization independence. Accessible only by the owning user or an administrator.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the customer who placed the parent order.

params.name: orderId
params.description: The unique identifier for the parent order.

params.name: orderItemId
params.description: The unique identifier for an item within an order.

params.name: bookingId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific event booking.

params.name: imageId
params.description: The unique identifier for a gallery image.

Collection to define administrative roles using the 'Existence over Content' pattern. A document existing here signifies that the corresponding userId has admin privileges. Used for enforcing admin-only write access to core data. Only rules should read this collection, and only backend should write to it.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of a user granted administrator privileges.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to be secure, scalable, and debuggable, adhering to all core design principles and strategy mandates. Authorization Independence is primarily achieved through a combination of **path-based ownership** and **denormalization of ownership fields**.

For `Product`, `GalleryImage`, and `CompanyInfo` entities, a simple top-level collection (`/products`, `/galleryImages`, `/companyInfo`) is used. These collections have a **public read security posture**, enabling anonymous users to browse content, and an **admin-only write posture** for management. This structural segregation ensures that public data is easily accessible and rules for these collections are straightforward: `allow read: true; allow write: if request.auth.uid in get(/roles_admin/$(request.auth.uid)).data;`.

For user-specific data, specifically `Order` and `EventBooking`, the structure leverages **hierarchical paths tied to the user's UID**. Orders are stored under `/users/{userId}/orders/{orderId}` and Event Bookings under `/users/{userId}/eventBookings/{bookingId}`. This design makes authorization extremely clear: a user can only access documents where `userId` in the path matches their `request.auth.uid`.

**CRITICAL: Authorization Independence for Orders and Event Bookings (Denormalization):** To eliminate the need for `get()` calls in security rules (a core mandate), every `Order` document and every `EventBooking` document **MUST include an `ownerId` field**. This `ownerId` field will store the `userId` (i.e., `request.auth.uid`) of the customer who placed the order or submitted the booking. Similarly, `OrderItem` documents, which are subcollections of `Order`, will also include the `ownerId` field denormalized from their parent `Order`. This allows rules for these paths to simply check `request.auth.uid == userId` AND `resource.data.ownerId == request.auth.uid`, ensuring atomic operations and simplified rule logic without cross-document lookups. This also makes the 'tracking page' securely accessible to authenticated users by filtering for `request.auth.uid` directly in the path.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters) Support:** The structural segregation and path-based ownership ensure QAPs are met. For public collections (`/products`, `/galleryImages`), `list` operations are implicitly secure as all documents are public. For user-owned data (`/users/{userId}/orders`, `/users/{userId}/eventBookings`), a `list` operation at `/users/{request.auth.uid}/orders` or `/users/{request.auth.uid}/eventBookings` will securely return only the authenticated user's documents, without requiring complex filtering logic in the rules. This adheres to the principle that Firestore rules enforce access, not filter results.

**DBAC and Global Roles:** Administrator roles are managed via a dedicated top-level collection `/roles_admin/{userId}`. The mere existence of a document at this path signifies that the `userId` associated with it has admin privileges. This uses the 'Existence over Content' pattern for roles, simplifying rule checks for administrative actions across the application.
